title: FHIR Resource Store Strategy Configuration
description: MongoDB layout, conformance overlays, import, semantic projection, generation, and fhir-mql search settings for FHIR R4, R5, and R6.

guidance.title: FHIR Core works immediately
guidance.body: Choose a release and database to start. An implementation guide or profile is optional.

guidance.title: Upload packages, then select profiles
guidance.body: Stage a FHIR NPM package in this form. Review its inventory, add it to the activation draft, and select zero or more profile canonical URLs.

guidance.title: CapabilityStatement is generated
guidance.body: The CapabilityStatement is runtime evidence derived from the active release, implemented interactions, and resource support. It is not an upload input.

database.title: Strategy database
database.description: Required strategy-owned MongoDB database for FHIR resources. Review this value during activation.

schema_version.title: FHIR release
schema_version.description: FHIR release. R4 is currently a minimal Patient/Observation interoperability baseline; R5 and R6 are package-backed.

collection_prefix.title: Collection prefix
collection_prefix.description: Optional prefix for per-resource-type collection names

import.title: Import limits
import.description: Safety limits for direct Resource, Bundle, and NDJSON imports. Migration clients can submit larger sources as bounded chunks.

max_resources_per_request.title: Maximum resources per request
max_resources_per_request.description: Safety bound for one Bundle/NDJSON request; larger migrations are chunked by clients

search.title: FHIR Search projections
search.description: Mandatory projection and indexing contract used to compile supported FHIR Search parameters into ordinary MongoDB queries.

enabled.title: Enable FHIR Search
enabled.description: Required. FHIR Search is compiled to ordinary MongoDB filters; Atlas Search is not required.

denormalize_on_generate.title: Project generated resources
denormalize_on_generate.description: Mandatory invariant: project search and compartment fields before synthetic resources become visible

config_dir.title: Search configuration directory
config_dir.description: Override fhir-mql resource YAML directory; null uses bundled configs

compartment_definitions_dir.title: Compartment definitions directory
compartment_definitions_dir.description: Override compartment definitions; null uses bundled paths

auto_index.title: Ensure search indexes
auto_index.description: Mandatory invariant: ensure resource search indexes before writes

implementation_guides.title: Implementation guides and profiles
implementation_guides.description: Optional customer or jurisdictional FHIR NPM packages layered over the selected FHIR Core release. Omit packages to use base conformance mode.

compiled_root.title: Compiled artifact directory
compiled_root.description: Local destination for immutable, checksum-addressed activation artifacts. Required when packages are configured.

packages.title: FHIR NPM packages
packages.description: Optional FHIR NPM package archives staged and inspected for this environment. Uploading adds a package to the draft; activation is still explicit.

enabled.title: Include package
enabled.description: Include this package in the activation overlay.

source.title: Staged package source
source.description: Local FHIR NPM package directory or .tgz archive. Packages are never downloaded on a request path.

sha256.title: SHA-256 checksum
sha256.description: Optional pinned package checksum verified during activation.

active_profiles.title: Active profile URLs
active_profiles.description: Optional canonical profile URLs selected from enabled IG packages. Empty keeps the store unconstrained. Selection is reported separately from profile validation.

profile_validation.description: Optional fail-closed profile enforcement through a configured validation adapter.

mode.title: Profile enforcement
mode.description: Disabled records selected profiles without enforcing them. Required rejects resources when the configured validator cannot confirm conformance.

binding.title: Validation provider binding
binding.description: Environment adapter name used for profile and invariant validation.

fail_on_warning.title: Treat warnings as errors
fail_on_warning.description: When enabled, validator warnings prevent the write as well as errors.

terminology_validation.title: Terminology validation
terminology_validation.description: Optional validation of Coding values through the tenant terminology gateway. Only explicitly listed canonical systems are inspected.

mode.title: Validation mode
mode.description: Disabled skips terminology checks, advisory records findings, and required rejects invalid or unverifiable governed codes.

binding.title: Terminology provider binding
binding.description: Environment terminology route used for lookup and validation, such as the native SNOMED CT service or an external FHIR terminology server.

systems.title: Governed code systems
systems.description: Canonical code-system URLs to validate. Empty means no systems are checked unless selected profiles introduce binding requirements.

max_codings_per_resource.title: Maximum codings per resource
max_codings_per_resource.description: Safety limit for terminology checks performed on one resource.

index_policy.title: Index policy
index_policy.description: Generated index governance. Indexes are always ensured before writes; activation-time materialization is optional.

max_managed_indexes_per_collection.title: Managed index budget
max_managed_indexes_per_collection.description: Maximum accelerator-managed indexes per collection, excluding MongoDB's built-in _id index.

materialize_on_activation.title: Create all indexes during activation
materialize_on_activation.description: Create every configured resource index during activation. False uses lazy per-resource materialization before writes.

semantic.title: Semantic projections
semantic.description: Optional, rebuildable semantic projections. Canonical FHIR resources are never modified and no embedding request runs during activation.

enabled.title: Enable semantic pipelines
enabled.description: Enables declared extraction pipelines. Activation does not generate embeddings; preview and materialization remain explicit operations.

pipelines.description: Optional semantic extraction pipelines. Start from the clinical-note example, then review every resource type and path before activation.

id.description: Stable identifier for this semantic extraction pipeline.

enabled.description: Whether this pipeline is available for preview and explicit materialization.

resource_types.description: Resource types from which this pipeline may extract text.

profiles.description: Optional canonical profile URLs that restrict when this pipeline applies.

fields.description: FHIR paths whose textual values are combined into semantic source text.

path.description: FHIRPath-like dot path rooted at a supported resource type.

label.description: Optional human-readable label stored with the extracted chunk.

separator.description: Text inserted between values extracted from configured fields.

max_source_chars.description: Maximum extracted source-text length before chunking.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters in one semantic chunk.

overlap_chars.description: Characters repeated between adjacent chunks to preserve context.

embedding.description: Embedding provider and vector-shape contract used only during explicit materialization or semantic search.

binding.description: Environment adapter name for the embedding provider.

model.description: Provider model identifier recorded with generated vectors.

dimensions.description: Expected vector dimensions used to reject incompatible provider output.

trigger.description: Semantic materialization is explicit; imports never invoke an embedding provider automatically.

storage.description: Rebuildable sidecar storage and optional Atlas Vector Search index binding.

mode.description: Keeps generated vectors outside canonical FHIR resources.

collection.description: MongoDB collection that stores rebuildable semantic chunks and embeddings.

vector_index.description: Atlas Vector Search index used only by explicit semantic retrieval.

generation.title: Synthetic data generation
generation.description: Defaults and named recipes used only when a user explicitly starts synthetic generation after activation.

seed.description: Default random seed for reproducible synthetic generation.

use_enrichers.description: Apply fhir-gen enrichers when generating resources

recipes.title: Generation recipes

description.description: Human-readable purpose and intended use of the recipe.

resources.description: Resource-type counts generated by this flat recipe.

scenarios.description: Named generator scenarios applied by this recipe.

seed.description: Recipe-specific random seed overriding the generation default.

recipes.description: Named generation recipes; merged from specification/recipes.json at load time

watermark.title: Synthetic-data watermark
watermark.description: Marks generated resources so synthetic data can be identified after persistence.

enabled.description: Add a synthetic provenance meta.tag and extension before MongoDB save.

max_count.description: Server maximum result count enforced across all input forms (URL _count, structured, internal ops).

default_count.description: Default page size applied when a request specifies no _count.
